distribution.name: cards.csv
distribution.description: This is the csv file for the dataset. It has 5 columns and one row for each of the total number of images in the dataset(8154 rows) The filepaths column contains the relative path to the image file. The labels column contains the label associated with the image file(there are 53 types of labels). The card type column specifies the rank of the card associated with the image file. There are 13 card ranks(ace, king, queen....two, joker). The dataset column defines which dataset the file belongs to (either train, test or valid). The class index column is the class index value of the files label.

name: Cards Image Dataset-Classification
description: This is a very high quality dataset of playing card images. All images are 224 X 224 X 3 in jpg format. All images in the dataset have been cropped so that only the image of a single card is present and the card occupies well over 50% of the pixels in the image. There are 7624 training images, 265 test images and 265 validation images. The train, test and validation directories are partitioned into 53 sub directories , one for each of the 53 types of cards. The dataset also includes a csv file which can be used to load the datasets.
